issue_context.title: Aranet integration should set `entity_category=EntityCategory.DIAGNOSTIC` for the battery sensor
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Battery is shown but comes up in the automatic lovelace dashboards, etc. Other integrations typically use `DIAGNOSTIC` for batteries, since it's not part of the set of interesting measurements for a device.

See https://developers.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/10/26/config-entity/ and https://developers.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/10/26/config-entity/.

You could also set this on "Update Interval" instead of doing `entity_registry_enabled_default=False`. From the comment in the code "interval setting is not a generally useful entity for most users", it looks like this would be a perfect fit.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.6.3
